messages:
leo_sales: quick thread  Acme asked to put two separate invoicing entities on the order form (US parent + EU subsidiary) and wants to add an AML/sanctions screening line in the MSA. also they want both legal + AP to sign. any redlines or blockers?

claire_legal: we can do a one-page addendum that enumerates signing entities and scope. AML ok but must be limited to transaction screening/compliance checks. no new indefinite warranties or indemnities. need exact legal entity names + tax/vat ids. also prefer the order form to reference the addendum rather than editing base MSA.

ben_finance: finance will require `PO required` on the order form and invoice remit details. Net30 is our default. if they insist on Net45 we need credit approval. can offer Net45 with a 1.5% early-pay discount as a concession.

omar_eng: technical hard stop: for Dedicated POC we cannot provide VPN/console creds or any infra endpoints until a DPA amendment that lists the EU subsidiary is executed. this is a gating item for provisioning.

tess_cs: buyer says their procurement system wants HSM-backed audit trail for signatures but they'll accept DocuSign if we include an amendment to migrate signatures later. do we support migration to HSM?

claire_legal: yes. include clause: "Interim e-signatures via DocuSign are accepted. Parties may migrate to HSM-backed signature workflow upon mutual written agreement; migration shall not affect the effective date or performance obligations." also include a signing matrix mapping signer -> invoicing entity -> data processing role.

leo_sales: can we do split-signing? ie EU legal signs for EU entity VAT, US parent signs finance piece?

claire_legal: allowed as long as the addendum ties each signature to its entity and the order value is consolidated. i'll add mapping language.

tess_cs: update from buyer: EU entity = "Acme Europe GmbH" VAT DE123456789; US parent = "Acme Global, Inc." EIN 98-7654321. billing contact eu-invoice@acme.example / us-invoice@acme.example. they want finance + legal signers.

ben_finance: got billing contacts. please include the remit addresses and `PO required` boolean field on the order form. we'll route invoices according to the invoicing entity.

omar_eng: reiterating gating: no POC endpoints until DPA amendment is signed and countersigned. tag infra when signed so we can flip provisioning.

esign-bot: created envelope env-1754-acme-multi for `orderform-acme-multi` (DocuSign)  awaiting legal + finance signatures.

claire_legal: i'll draft the addendum + DPA patch and drop a PR in ~2 hours for quick review. will include AML limited language, signing matrix, and the interim signature migration clause.

leo_sales: thanks all. plan: hold provisioning until signed order form + DPA; can run internal preflight while legal reviews. i'll update the buyer that DocuSign in place but HSM migration clause included. :thumbsup:

esign-bot: envelope env-1754-acme-multi updated: legal signer completed. awaiting finance signer.
